comparison.objective: Pack bottle, shoes, wallet, and headphones into a gym bag, with later specs separating dirty shoes from clean accessories.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-object packing and spatial grouping inside a deformable-looking container.
comparison.success_condition: Objects fully contained, released, still for 40 controls; later version also requires 120 mm separation between groups.
comparison.reason: Multi-object packing is opposite in outcome to separating a mixture through a tool. Spec versions differ on grouping and point allocation, but neither overlaps the candidate ability.
